fact: 1949年1月，苏联、保加利亚、捷克斯洛伐克、匈牙利、波兰、罗马尼亚六国在莫斯科成立经济互助委员会（COMECON），作为对马歇尔计划与西欧一体化的回应；阿尔巴尼亚2月加入，民主德国1950年9月加入。

sources.title: COUNCIL FOR MUTUAL ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE SIGNIFICANT FEATURES AND TRENDS (Bulgarian MFA)
sources.quote: The COUNCIL FOR MUTUAL ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE was founded in January 1949 - the first meeting of the USSR and its associates at the state level. The original members were the USSR, Bulgaria, Czechoslovakia, Hungary, Poland and Rumania. Albania joined the following month, the GDR in September 1950.

sources.title: The International Bank for Economic Cooperation (IMF Staff Papers)
sources.quote: In January 1949 a Council for Mutual Economic Assistance (CMEA) was established to serve as the institutional framework for economic cooperation among the countries in Eastern Europe and the U.S.S.R.

fact: 1949年5月5日，比利时、丹麦、法国、爱尔兰、意大利、卢森堡、荷兰、挪威、瑞典、英国十国外长在伦敦圣詹姆斯宫签署《欧洲委员会规章》，欧洲委员会（Council of Europe）成立。

sources.title: Statute of the Council of Europe is signed in London (Council of Europe)
sources.quote: On 5 May 1949, at St James's Palace, London, the Foreign Ministers of Belgium, Denmark, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Sweden and the United Kingdom signed the Treaty establishing the Council of Europe.

sources.title: Origins and History of Parliamentary Assembly (Council of Europe)
sources.quote: On 5th May, 1949 the five Governments Members of the Brussels Treaty and the Governments of Denmark, Ireland, Italy, Norway and Sweden signed in London the Statute of this new body, the Council of Europe.

fact: 1949年4月4日，美国、加拿大与10个西欧国家在华盛顿签署《北大西洋公约》，NATO成立；1949年1月COMECON成立，标志着欧洲在经济与军事上同时分裂为两个阵营。

sources.title: Founding treaty (NATO official)
sources.quote: The foundations of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) were officially laid down on 4 April 1949 with the signing of the North Atlantic Treaty.

sources.title: COUNCIL FOR MUTUAL ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE (Bulgarian MFA)
sources.quote: The COUNCIL FOR MUTUAL ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE was founded in January 1949.

fact: 1949年布雷顿森林体系进入固定汇率阶段：英镑9月18日贬值到2.80美元、日元4月固定为360日元兑1美元、德国马克1948年6月已在西占区发行；到10月18日共28国同步调整本币对美元汇率。

sources.title: READJUSTMENT OF FOREIGN CURRENCY VALUES (FRASER, Federal Reserve Bulletin)
sources.quote: By October 18, twenty-eight countries adjusted downward the dollar values of their currencies. These included countries in the sterling area and most Western European nations.

sources.title: THE YEN-DOLLAR RELATIONSHIP (Federal Reserve Board)
sources.quote: In April 1949, the official Japanese exchange rate was established at 360 yen = US$1.

fact: 1949年9月18日英镑贬值30.5%引发28国同步贬值；到10月18日，英镑区与多数西欧国家均下调本币对美元汇率，这是战后布雷顿森林体系首次大规模汇率调整。

sources.title: READJUSTMENT OF FOREIGN CURRENCY VALUES (FRASER)
sources.quote: Devaluation of the pound sterling by 30.5 per cent in terms of the dollar, announced on September 18, 1949, initiated a realignment of foreign exchange values on a scale unprecedented for a short period of time.

sources.title: Sterling Exchange Rate (Hansard, 27 September 1949)
sources.quote: We fixed the rate at 2.80 dollars to the pound, that is, a 30 per cent reduction in value of the pound.

fact: 1949年8月29日苏联在塞米巴拉金斯克试爆第一颗原子弹RDS-1，美国核垄断结束；1949年7月27日英国德·哈维兰彗星喷气客机首飞，民用喷气时代开启。

sources.title: Испытание первой атомной бомбы в СССР (РИА Новости)
sources.quote: 29 августа 1949 года на Семипалатинском полигоне (Казахстан) прошли успешные испытания первого советского заряда для атомной бомбы.

sources.title: de Havilland DH.106 Comet 1 and 2 (BAE Systems Heritage)
sources.quote: The first prototype of the Comet, flown on 27th July 1949, demonstrated ground-breaking advancements in flight performance. The Comet was the world's first pressurized commercial jet airliner.

fact: 1949年全球经济从战后混乱走向固定汇率与阵营分治：西欧通过欧洲委员会与NATO整合，东欧通过COMECON整合，日本通过道奇路线纳入美元体系，中国通过人民币统一与中苏同盟纳入社会主义阵营。

sources.title: The Reconstruction and Stabilization of the Postwar Japanese Economy (Yale)
sources.quote: The austere Dodge stabilization policy was necessary to stabilize the economy but it triggered a severe recession, which was cut short by the coincidental outbreak of the Korean War.

sources.title: External Economic Relations (Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan)
sources.quote: The yen's exchange rate was set at 360 yen to the dollar in December 1949 and an austerity program imposed to maintain the yen's value.
